equation_summary: Per token with matrix state S in R^{K x V}: delta = beta_t * (v_t - k_t^T S_{t-1}); S_t = S_{t-1} + k_t delta_t^T (no decay, G=I); o_t = q_t^T S_t with q pre-scaled by 1/sqrt(d_k). This is exactly the canonical delta law with c=1, beta present, no gate: delta-rule-recurrence at naive.py:27-35 does retrieve-from-UNdecayed state, rank-1 write, then read after update. Initial state added at start, final state returned; q,k L2-normed and beta=sigmoid (optionally x2) in the layer, all external.
